item_summary: $80-120 high-resolution 4K webcam with AI auto-framing, low-light correction, and dual noise-canceling microphones
detailed_item_draft: Specification for 4K Web Camera: Budget range $80 to $120. Must support 3840x2160 resolution at 30fps or higher with HDR for superior low-light performance and color accuracy. Integrated AI processor required for intelligent auto-framing to track and center subject automatically. Audio system must feature dual noise-canceling microphones with beamforming to isolate voice and suppress ambient noise. Connectivity via USB 3.0 (Type-A or Type-C) with UVC driver support for immediate plug-and-play functionality on Windows and macOS. Chassis to include universal monitor clip and tripod mount thread. Ideal for remote work and content creation.
